summary: Frontend testing of Splash Screen, Local Transfer receiver currency field, and International Selector 3-card redesign. ALL TESTS PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: SplashScreen.js implements premium splash with 3D logo (DIE), breathing animation, progress bar, and accessibility support (prefers-reduced-motion)
SplashScreen supports dark/light mode with gradient backgrounds (slate-900 for dark, amber-50/white for light)
LocalTransfer.js has new receiverCurrency field with IQD/USD options and proper data-testid='receiver-currency-select'
LocalTransfer summary correctly shows: USD amount, IQD equivalent, receiver currency, service fee (2%), and total
InternationalSelector.js redesigned with 3-card premium layout (Western Union, MoneyGram, Country-based)
InternationalSelector has badges ('Most Popular' on WU, 'New Experience' on Country-based) and trust indicators
All cards have proper data-testid attributes and navigate correctly to their respective pages
Theme toggle works correctly on all tested pages (dark/light mode)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: Splash Screen with 3D logo and animations, Local Transfer with receiver currency (IQD/USD) and USD→IQD conversion summary, International Selector with 3-card premium layout. Theme toggle works on all pages.
